result.source: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates
result.attribution: Source: European Central Bank. Reference rates are published for information purposes only.
result.note: ECB reference rates (about 30 currencies, no crypto); weekends and holidays use the previous working day.

trust.source: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates
trust.verification_method: Fetched by a deterministic collector (no AI model) from the source over HTTPS on a fixed schedule; parsed and checked before replacing the previous copy; if a fetch fails the last good copy is kept and marked stale.
limitations: Reference rates for information, not transaction rates.
Published on ECB working days only.
BOTERNITY checks that values come unchanged from the source, not that the source is right.
